leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript interface to define the structure of an object.
Apply an interface to enforce type safety on a function parameter.
Construct an object that adheres to a specified interface.
Update an existing interface by adding new required properties.
Manipulate an array of objects typed with an interface.
Initialize a variable with an object that satisfies multiple interfaces.
Configure optional properties within an interface definition.
